Careful index management or resetting will be crucial to ensure proper row alignment and prevent unintended NaN insertion.

This creates an inconsistent dataset that could introduce errors in subsequent analysis or modeling steps. I see the index misalignment causing NaN values when concatenating the dataframes. By using `reset_index(drop=True)` on both `df_tmp` and `df_TSNE`, we'll create matching indices that enable clean concatenation without introducing NaN values.
